gpt2_investigation.conclusion: Reproduced accuracy-regression candidate with unresolved attribution; fixed automatic threshold is not met (28/141). No reduced cross-version accuracy reproducer or compiler defect confirmation.

reduction.note: Graph localization establishes a separate graph predicate after full-model isolation. Signatures do not prove identical root cause. No global minimality claim.

reduction_policy.scope: Candidate primary failure localization only; does not preserve the cross-version accuracy ratio.

limitations: Fixed two-image/two-passage inputs are not representative production traffic.
CPU uses default execution; AMD uses explicit deterministic execution in both environments. Changes from 0.9 cannot be attributed solely to new advisory logic.
CPU torchvision versions differ. AMD release-version baseline uses AMD nightly SDK packaging, not the stable channel.
Unsupported fp64 backward operations, layouts, saved-mask limits, and max-pool gaps remain missing evidence.
Ratios use each version's own eager and fp64 results; absolute errors and conditioning still matter.
No NVIDIA validation, throughput result, optimizer-step test, or new confirmed upstream defect.

diagnostic_validation.note: Autocast MLP gradients exceeded the unchanged per-output dtype thresholds. This is a numerical finding, not a confirmed compiler bug. CUDA/ROCm checks require external hardware validation.

pretrained_sweep_validation.counting: Each model/device pair contributes once to labels present in either version. Unexplained findings include pairs where either failing version lacks sufficient evidence; labels can overlap.
pretrained_sweep_validation.evidence_note: The sweep used the source fingerprint recorded in each environment. Afterward, preparation metadata was changed to serialize Transformers loading-info key sets as sorted lists. Numerical comparison and triage code were unchanged. A real cached checkpoint check verified identical weights and inputs after this preparation-only fix.

inputs.scope: Two real photographs and two public-domain prose paragraphs; not a representative accuracy dataset.

limitations: Two dog photographs and two literary passages do not represent production traffic.
Text models expose final hidden states; prediction heads, generation caches, and optimizer steps are not tested.
Torchvision builds differ between the CPU environments; these are environment comparisons, not isolated PyTorch commit comparisons.
Both AMD builds use the same ROCm nightly SDK packaging; the 2.15 release-version baseline is not an AMD stable-channel package.
Unsupported diagnostic layouts, bounded saved-mask storage, and max-pool selector coverage remain explicit gaps.

Six AMD model pairs had unstable repeated eager references and did not reach compiler comparison. SmolLM2 exceeded the host RSS budget during diagnostics in all four environments; primary observations are retained.
No NVIDIA result, throughput claim, or newly confirmed upstream bug is established.
